items.title_zh: 长安汽车：行业进入存量博弈阶段，利润率降至历史低位
items.title_en: Changan Auto: Industry Enters Stock Competition, Margins at Historic Low; Advances L3/L4 and Full-Stack Self-Developed Smart Driving
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，9 月 24 日，长安汽车发布新一期投资者关系活动记录表。 长安汽车提到，当前，汽车行业面临国内市场承压与国际形势复杂多变的双重挑战。国内市场方面，随着前期补贴政策退坡、消费者观望情绪加重，内需增速显著放缓； 行业进入存量博弈阶段，利润率降至历史低位 。面对市场竞争加剧，公司坚持价值导向、量利平衡的经营原则，主动规避恶性价格竞争，聚焦产品与服务打造差异化竞争力。坚持长期主义，坚持品牌向上，坚定高端化升级、技术创新、生态融合、全球化发展。 IT之家从公告获悉，长安汽车还透露，公司在三电和智能化领域均已进行系统布局。三电方面， 公司已实现电池、电驱、电控产业布局全覆盖 ：电池领域打造了“金钟罩”电池品牌，获 2025 年国家科技进步二等奖；电驱领域，量产行业首款多合一电驱，太行分布式电驱技术正式迈入量产与普及阶段；电控领域，行业首发“七合一”跨域融合 SVDC。 智能化方面，长安汽车继去年 12 月获得国内首块 L3 级自动驾驶专用正式号牌后，今年又获批 L4 级自研 Robotaxi 测试牌照，成为拥有全合规、全场景 L4 级无人驾驶实测资格的车企；2026 年 9 月 4 日公司正式发布天枢领航，为公司全栈自研的智能辅助驾驶解决方案，全系搭载激光雷达、全系采用“端到端”技术，目前天枢领航已进入量产上车阶段。长安汽车表示， 将持续推进电池技术的自主研发…
items.summary_en: Changan Automobile said China's auto industry has entered a stock-competition phase, with domestic demand slowing and profit margins at historic lows. The company plans to avoid destructive price wars and focus on value, premiumization, technology, and globalization. It has full in-house layouts in batteries, e-motors, and electronic controls, and has obtained L3 and L4 autonomous driving credentials; its full-stack "TianShu" assisted driving solution is entering mass production.
items.why_zh: 长安的表态反映了中国车企在价格战与需求放缓下的经营策略转向，其智能化进度也显示传统车企正加速L3/L4落地。
items.why_en: Changan's comments reflect how Chinese automakers are shifting strategy amid price wars and slowing demand, while its L3/L4 progress shows traditional carmakers accelerating autonomous driving deployment.

items.title_en: The Pentagon wants $30 million to build an AI-powered lie detector
items.summary_zh: 美国国防部预算请求显示，未来五年计划投入3030万美元升级测谎技术，项目名为“Polygraph+”或“Polygraph Next”。该项目重点开发基于人工智能与机器学习的评分算法，以及无需在受试者身上连接设备即可读取生理信号的“远距离传感”技术。据Inside Defense首次报道，预算文件称该项目旨在推动联邦测谎技术现代化。该计划引发对AI测谎可靠性及隐私伦理的讨论。
items.summary_en: The US government wants to spend $30.3 million over the next five years on an improved form of lie detector, according to a Department of Defense budget request . The program, called “Polygraph+” or “Polygraph Next”, will focus on scoring algorithms that use artificial intelligence and machine learning and on a technique called “standoff sensing”, which refers to the ability to take physiological readings from a subject without attaching a device to their person. According to details of the budget document, which were first reported by Inside Defense , the project will “modernize federal polyg…
items.why_zh: 将AI用于测谎可能改变执法与安全审查手段，但其科学可靠性和隐私风险仍存争议。
items.why_en: Using AI for lie detection could reshape law enforcement and security screening, but its scientific reliability and privacy risks remain controversial.

items.title_zh: AOC 推出 34 英寸 G4 宙斯盾带鱼屏显示器：WQHD 200Hz，国补价 1613.7 元
items.title_en: AOC Launches 34-Inch G4 Aegis Ultrawide Monitor CU34G4H: WQHD 200Hz at 1,613.7 Yuan With Subsidy
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，冠捷推出了一款新的 AOC G4 宙斯盾系列显示器，型号为 CU34G4H，京东显示为 1793 元，叠加国补后 1613.7 元。 京东 AOC 34 英寸带鱼屏显示器 CU34G4H HVA HDR 出厂校色 21:9 曲面 1500R 电竞 1793 元 直达链接 这款 34 英寸显示器采用 Fast VA 快速液晶面板，有着 WQHD 分辨率、200Hz 刷新率、21:9 比例、1500R 曲率、0.3ms MPRT / 1ms GTG 响应时间，搭配 MBR Sync 自研插帧同步技术，可有效消除运动模糊和拖影，同时兼容 G-Sync 和 FreeSync 技术。 这款显示器拥有 4000:1 静态对比度，覆盖 100% sRGB 色域、95% DCI-P3 色域，支持 True 8bit 色深，出厂逐台校色，保证 ΔE＜2 (CIE2000)，同时支持 HDR 10 高动态解析，峰值亮度达 300 cd/m²。 功能方面，它内置 AI 智慧质控引擎，包含 Dark Boost 亮暗部动态细节增强技术，提供三档优化设置，改善亮部过曝、暗部死黑问题，同时支持 PIP / PBP 智能分屏，可同时显示两路信号，实现多任务并行处理。 针对电竞玩家，它还专为 FPS 游戏定制了丰富的辅助功能，包括 GameColor 灰阶色彩调节、FPS 狙击镜、…
items.summary_en: AOC has launched the 34-inch CU34G4H ultrawide gaming monitor in its G4 Aegis line, listed at 1,793 yuan on JD.com and 1,613.7 yuan after a national subsidy. It packs a Fast VA panel with WQHD resolution, 21:9 aspect ratio, 1500R curvature, 200Hz refresh rate and 0.3ms MPRT / 1ms GTG response, plus MBR Sync, G-Sync and FreeSync support. It offers 4000:1 contrast, 100% sRGB and 95% DCI-P3 coverage, True 8bit color, factory calibration (ΔE<2), HDR 10, an AI quality-control engine with Dark Boost, PIP/PBP split screen and FPS-oriented aids.
items.why_zh: 200Hz 高刷带鱼屏电竞显示器在国补后落到 1600 元档，说明高规格曲面电竞屏的价格门槛正进一步下探。
items.why_en: A 200Hz ultrawide gaming monitor dropping to roughly 1,600 yuan with subsidies shows how quickly high-spec curved gaming displays are getting cheaper.

items.summary_en: According to Dongqiudi, four AI models gave predictions for the Italy vs Belgium match, and they disagree: two favor a home win for Italy, while ByteDance's Doubao expects a draw. The report offers only the outcome-level comparison, without detailing each model's reasoning or scoreline predictions.
items.why_zh: 体育赛事竞猜正成为大模型落地的一种轻量级测试场景，不同模型在同一场比赛上的分歧也直观展示了预测能力的差异。
items.why_en: Sports prediction is becoming a lightweight test bed for large models, and their disagreement on a single match offers a visible look at differences in predictive performance.

items.why_zh: 同一批模型在连续两场赛事中呈现相似分歧，说明 AI 体育预测的稳定性与准确性仍待检验。
items.why_en: The same models showing similar disagreement across two matches suggests AI sports predictions still need validation for consistency and accuracy.

items.why_en: It captures the tension between capital's appetite and a leading LLM firm's funding stance, relevant to sector valuations.

items.why_en: It shows LLM voice assistants are becoming a key differentiator in smart-vehicle cockpits.

items.title_zh: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯在最后一次联大演讲中呼吁对人工智能进行全球监管
items.title_en: UN Secretary‑General Antonio Guterres calls for global regulation of artificial intelligence in final UNGA address
items.summary_zh: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯在其任内最后一次联合国大会一般性辩论讲话中，呼吁对人工智能实施全球性监管。他强调，AI 的快速发展已超出单一国家或企业所能掌控的范围，需要国际社会共同制定规则加以约束。此番表态出现在其卸任前的收官演讲中，被外界视为对全球 AI 治理议题的再次定调。目前各国在 AI 监管路径上分歧明显，联合国层面的呼吁能否转化为具体机制仍有待观察。
items.summary_en: UN Secretary‑General Antonio Guterres calls for global regulation of artificial intelligence in final UNGA address Digital Watch Observatory
items.why_zh: 联合国最高层在联大这一多边舞台上呼吁全球 AI 监管，可能推动 AI 治理从各国各自为政走向国际协调。
items.why_en: A call from the UN's top official at the General Assembly could push AI governance from fragmented national rules toward international coordination.

items.title_zh: 【视频】恐怖故事竟能自动调灯开按摩？豆包AI车机拟人化拉满

items.summary_en: A video from Autohome showcases ByteDance's Doubao AI in a car cockpit: when a user tells a horror story, the assistant reacts by adjusting interior lighting and massage functions, making the interaction feel more human. items.why_en: In-car AI is shifting from a voice assistant to a human-like agent that controls vehicle hardware, becoming a key differentiator for smart cars.
